content: {"praised":["Atmosphere is rich and lush, dark and sensual.","Fresh twist on vampire legend, morality tale.","Different view on prejudice, less blood-sucking focus.","Characters show strength and anger, dark quietness.","Story offers uneasy truce between cop and vampire."],"criticized":["Acting is wooden and poor, especially by Woodbine.","Plot lacks development, feels doomed from start.","Film is boring and annoying, dull pacing.","Vampire concept feels cliché, too similar to X-Men.","Overall execution feels incomplete, lacking depth."]}
